source_caption:
📺 Eli Stone (2008–2009)

Eli Stone follows a successful San Francisco attorney whose seemingly perfect life takes an unexpected turn when he begins experiencing mysterious visions that disrupt his career and personal relationships. Initially believing his strange experiences are caused by a medical condition, Eli soon discovers that his visions may carry deeper meanings, guiding him toward people who desperately need his help. As he struggles to understand his unusual abilities, he begins questioning his priorities and the kind of lawyer he wants to become. With support from his friends, family, and spiritual mentor, Eli takes on challenging legal cases that often put him at odds with powerful corporations and his own colleagues. Starring Jonny Lee Miller, Victor Garber, Natasha Henstridge, and Loretta Devine, the series combines heartfelt drama, courtroom battles, humor, and supernatural mysteries while exploring faith, destiny, justice, love, and the importance of making a difference in people’s lives.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Fantasy • Legal Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Greg Berlanti & Marc Guggenheim

📺 Seasons: 2 • 26 Episodes

source_details.title: Eli Stone
source_details.synopsis: Eli Stone is an American comedy legal drama television series created by Greg Berlanti and Marc Guggenheim. They served as executive producers alongside Ken Olin, who directed the pilot, with Melissa Berman producing. The series aired on ABC from January 31, 2008, to July 11, 2009, for two seasons. The series follows Stone (Jonny Lee Miller), a San Francisco lawyer who begins to have hallucinations (such as a George Michael soundtrack that only he can hear and getting dive-bombed by a World War I biplane on a busy San Francisco street) which leads him to two possible conclusions: side effects from his potentially fatal brain aneurysm, or the chance that something greater is at work.
